key_points: CEO David Solomon warned of softer fixed‑income trading and rising expenses for Q3, pushing the stock down ~4%
Goldman completed a $11.7 bn private‑equity fundraising, a positive but likely already priced‑in development
Management highlighted a $70 bn revenue target and growth in asset‑wealth lines, offering some upside
Fed’s first rate hike in three years could pressure margins and adds uncertainty
Short‑term sentiment is negative, but no fundamental shift to the long‑term thesis
